topic: He only writes after midnight — by day you don't exist

hook_options.headline: 00:47 voice note. 2:20 PM — no ticks.
hook_options.why_it_swipes: Two times, two objects. Thumbnail reads in two seconds: night voice vs daylight silence.

hook_options.headline: Midnight «I need you» is not closeness
hook_options.why_it_swipes: Breaks the romance of the night text: heat without a daylight seat is not a choice.

hook_options.headline: You slide sleep to his 1:12 AM
hook_options.why_it_swipes: Cost is on her side: she gives the night as if it were proof.

hook_options.headline: Window 12–3 AM. No seat by day.
hook_options.why_it_swipes: Structure, not character: a night window, no daylight slot.

hook_options.headline: 3 checks: light, sober day, a door
hook_options.why_it_swipes: A test for 2 PM, when the hand reaches to wait for midnight.

hook_rationale: Pain hook with 00:47 vs 2:20 PM: a voice note against missing ticks. Information gap without theory — closeness, or hours without witnesses? Compressed for the 01 cell. Not a weekend hook. Not «you up?» after silence.

slides.headline: 00:47 voice note. 2:20 PM — no ticks.
slides.animal_metaphor: owl on night watch at the phone — sees a window that daylight does not have
slides.notes: Situation 00:47 vs 2:20 PM. Owl + phone/lamp. Readable in 2 seconds. No mechanic title.

slides.headline: Chosen at night. Empty by day.
slides.body: At 00:47 you feel picked. At 2:20 PM you check the chat as if midnight could move into daylight. It didn't. You wait on his clock, not yours.
slides.animal_metaphor: dog on duty at a dark daytime screen — loyal to his hours, not her day
slides.notes: Pain: she lives inside his night window. Not a verdict on him — her clock.

slides.headline: You slide sleep to his 1:12 AM
slides.body: You shift your night to his text and call it the real us. That is not proof. That is your night given to his window.
slides.animal_metaphor: dog breaks its own sleep for someone else's clock — cost on her side
slides.notes: Mistake is her sleep shift, not a label on him.

slides.headline: Midnight is hours without witnesses
slides.body: He has a window from midnight to 3 AM. In his daylight schedule there is no seat for you. Night heat is not a place in his day.
slides.animal_metaphor: owl looks through a night window, not an altar — mechanism, not romance

slides.headline: Says / Hears / Is
slides.body:
Says: «I can only text at night.»
Hears: «I'm the exception.»
Is: you are not in his day.
slides.animal_metaphor: cat catches the swap — senses the gap between the line and the fact
slides.notes: Save decoder. Constructive, not a verdict.

slides.headline: 3 daylight checks
slides.body:
1. Does he write in daylight?
2. Does he write in a sober day?
3. Is there a door besides the night channel?
slides.animal_metaphor: cat counts three daylight doors — not one night gate
slides.notes: Save: exactly three checks for the afternoon.

slides.headline: 3 questions before his midnight
slides.body:
1. Did he write today in the light?
2. Am I waiting for 00:00 or living my day?
3. If the night vanishes — what is left?
slides.animal_metaphor: dog stands up from the screen — leaves the midnight watch
slides.notes: Save: questions that give the night back. Do not stand watch at 00:00.

slides.headline: Night without day is a window
slides.body: Rule: a place in his life shows in daylight. If you exist only after midnight, you are not in his day.
slides.animal_metaphor: owl closes the night shift with a rule for morning

slides.headline: Comment MIDNIGHT
slides.animal_metaphor: owl holds the trigger word — night as a code, not a romance
slides.notes: Word MIDNIGHT in the comments. DM: audio reading in the app. Essence–Shadow–Vector. Links in the profile. Not the bot.
